items.title: Google’s Pixel 11 isn’t the story; Gemini AI is
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor joins Josh Lipton on Market Domination Overtime to discuss Google's (GOOG, GOOGL) new Pixel 11 smartphone lineup and its deeper integration of Gemini AI.

items.title: Forget big tech: the real AI money is in plumbing
items.summary: Host Kenny Polcari joins Yahoo Finance's Jared Blikre and Founder ETFs' Michael Monaghan to explore the data showing why founder-led companies significantly outperform the market. The panel also breaks down the flawless execution of the SpaceX IPO, the overlooked opportunities in AI infrastructure, and why the next major productivity boom will mirror the historical shift from steam to electricity.

items.title: Apple Reportedly Negotiates Deals With Publishers For Real-Time Content To Power AI-Powered Siri
items.summary: Apple is negotiating multiyear licensing deals with media companies to supply current news content to its upgraded Siri voice assistant using a pay-per-use compensation model.

items.title: Apple in Talks to Pay Publishers to Improve AI-Powered Siri
items.summary: The content deals could provide the tech company’s voice assistant with current news and information.

items.title: Your Newborn’s Trump Account Auto-Buys This S&P 500 ETF: The Hidden Costs Parents Never See
items.summary: The government seeds your newborn's investment account with what looks like a nearly free S&P 500 ETF, but the fund fee is the smallest number on the bill. The real costs are buried in decisions the account made for you before your child took a first breath.

items.title: Magnificent Seven Earnings Remain Robust: MSFT, AAPL
items.summary: Several members of the group, including Microsoft (MSFT) and Apple (AAPL), posted solid results overall, though the post-earnings reaction was much stronger for MSFT.

items.title: Alphabet and Apple Are Among Berkshire Hathaway's Top Holdings. Here's What That Tells Us About CEO Greg Abel's Investing Style in Tech Stocks.
items.summary: Abel is following Warren Buffett's longstanding playbook of disciplined investing, but the conglomerate's portfolio is increasingly including tech stocks.

items.title: Apple’s CXMT Bet Could Strengthen Its Memory Supply, But Risks Remain
items.summary: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) is testing DRAM chips from China’s ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) across several product lines, including iPhones and MacBooks. The move comes as Apple deals with a tight memory supply market driven by strong demand from the artificial intelligence industry.
